# hubcap

> A dol (i.e. dict-like) interface to github


## Pages in this subsection

- [hubcap](hubcap.html.md): The simplest facade to github data.
- [hubcap.actions](hubcap.actions.html.md): GitHub Actions and CI status utilities.
- [hubcap.base](hubcap.base.html.md): Base objects
- [hubcap.casting](hubcap.casting.html.md): Transformation graph for GitHub project references with flexible input handling.
- [hubcap.constants](hubcap.constants.html.md): A place to put constants, defaults, types…
- [hubcap.repo_slurp](hubcap.repo_slurp.html.md): Tools to slurp a repo’s information
- [hubcap.snapshot](hubcap.snapshot.html.md): Incremental snapshot of GitHub orgs: issues, PRs and discussions with all comments.
- [hubcap.tools](hubcap.tools.html.md): A medley of tools for Hubcap.
- [hubcap.util](hubcap.util.html.md): Utils for hubcap.
